title: CANDiT: A machine learning framework for differentiation therapy in colorectal cancer.
authors: Sinha, Saptarshi; Alcantara, Joshua; Perry, Kevin; Castillo, Vanessa; Ondersma, Annelies K; Banerjee, Satarupa; McLaren, Ella; Espinoza, Celia R; Taheri, Sahar; Vidales, Eleadah; Tindle, Courtney; Adel, Adel; Amirfakhri, Siamak; Sawires, Joseph R; Yang, Jerry; Bouvet, Michael; Ghosh, Pradipta
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习框架CANDiT识别结直肠癌分化治疗靶点，虽涉及CDX2转录因子但核心是转录组表型与治疗响应，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Reactivating lineage commitment to differentiate, and hence eliminate, cancer stem cells (CSCs) remains a therapeutic challenge. Here, we present CANDiT (cancer-associated nodes for differentiation targeting), a machine learning framework that identifies transcriptomic vulnerabilities for differentiation therapy in colorectal cancer (CRC). Centering on CDX2-a master intestinal lineage factor lost in high-risk, poorly differentiated CRCs-we identify PRKAB1, a stress polarity sensor, as a top therapeutic target. A clinical-grade PRKAB1 agonist reactivates lineage programs, dismantles Wnt/YAP-driven stemness, and selectively eliminates CDX2-low CSCs across CRC cell lines, xenografts, and patient-derived organoids (PDOs). Multivariate analysis reveals a strong therapeutic index tied to the CDX2-low state. A 50-gene response signature, derived from integrated modeling across all platforms, predicts  approximately 50% reduction in recurrence and mortality risk. Like immunotherapy, CANDiT resurrects a physiologic program-differentiation-to selectively eliminate CSCs, offering a scalable, precision framework for lineage restoration in solid tumors.
abstract_zh: 重新激活谱系定向以分化并从而消除癌症干细胞（CSCs）仍是治疗上的挑战。在此，我们提出CANDiT（用于分化靶向的癌症相关节点），一种机器学习框架，用于识别结直肠癌（CRC）中分化治疗的转录组脆弱性。以CDX2为中心——一种在高风险、低分化CRC中缺失的肠道主谱系因子——我们识别出PRKAB1，一种应激极性传感器，作为首要治疗靶点。一种临床级PRKAB1激动剂可重新激活谱系程序，瓦解Wnt/YAP驱动的干性，并在CRC细胞系、异种移植瘤和患者来源类器官（PDOs）中选择性消除CDX2-low CSCs。多变量分析揭示了与CDX2-low状态相关的强治疗指数。一个50基因响应特征，源自跨所有平台的整合建模，预测复发和死亡风险约降低50%。与免疫治疗类似，CANDiT复活一种生理程序——分化——以选择性消除CSCs，为实体瘤中的谱系恢复提供可扩展的精准框架。
